question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard work remain bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway product work, or should some slices move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub ownership?
rationale: The issue spans product direction, persistent state, custom-widget sandboxing, install/publish trust, role visibility, and plugin API boundaries that cleanup automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Review Bundled Roadmap
options.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked PRs in dependency order with explicit security, storage, and plugin-boundary decisions before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Core Seams
options.body: Accept only generic extension/API gaps in OpenClaw and move optional widget packs, skills, registry, or tab-app bundles to plugin or ClawHub ownership.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Wave 2
options.body: Pause or close the roadmap if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboard expansion is not current product work.

recommendation.title: Review Bundled Roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked PRs in dependency order with explicit security, storage, and plugin-boundary decisions before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest adjacent product/security routing signal from the merged Logbook Control UI tab work and related dashboard precedent.
